requirements.original: **length:** restrictions for string length of string types and the number of elements for record of, set of and arrays;
requirements.canonical: The `length` matching attribute restricts the string length of a value of a string type and the number of elements of a `record of`, `set of` or array value.

requirements.original: **ifpresent: for matching of optional field values (if not omitted).**
requirements.canonical: The `ifpresent` matching attribute matches an optional field that is omitted, and applies the matching of the template it is attached to when the optional field is present.

readings: `ifpresent` matches an omitted optional field, and otherwise matches the present value against the template it is attached to.
`ifpresent` is used only for matching present (not omitted) optional field values.
ambiguity.issue: "for matching of optional field values (if not omitted)" does not say what happens with an omitted field; the first reading is chosen as it is consistent with annex B.1.4.2 and NOTE 2.

requirements.header: // @requirement: 15.7.4 -- **ifpresent: for matching of optional field values (if not omitted).**

requirements.original: NOTE 1: **ifpresent can be assigned to templates of any type as a whole or to optional fields of record and set types.** **ifpresent can only be used for matching optional fields.**
requirements.canonical: `ifpresent` CAN be assigned to a template of any type as a whole or to an optional field of a record or set type.
requirements.header: // @requirement: 15.7.4 -- NOTE 1: **ifpresent can be assigned to templates of any type as a whole or to optional fields of record and set types.** **ifpresent can only be used for matching optional fields.**

requirements.original: NOTE 2: Assigning ifpresent to a template that already matches the special value omit (i.e. it is either omit, an **ifpresent template or AnyValueOrNone) has no effect; the resulting template will match the same set of** values and the special value omit as the template the ifpresent is assigned to.
requirements.canonical: Assigning `ifpresent` to a template that already matches `omit` (i.e. `omit`, an `ifpresent` template or AnyValueOrNone) has no effect, and the resulting template matches the same set of values and `omit` as the original template.
requirements.header: // @requirement: 15.7.4 -- NOTE 2: Assigning ifpresent to a template that already matches the special value omit (i.e. it is either omit, an **ifpresent template or AnyValueOrNone) has no effect; the resulting template will match the same set of** values and the special value omit as the template the ifpresent is assigned to.

requirements.original: b) All values used in the length matching attribute shall be completely initialized.

requirements.original: Template restrictions are applicable to template definitions and template variables, formal template parameters, and return template types of functions.

requirements.original: (omit) the template shall resolve to a value matching mechanism (i.e. the fields of it shall resolve to a specific value or omit, and the whole template may also resolve to omit).
requirements.canonical: A template with the `omit` restriction SHALL resolve to a specific value or `omit`.

ambiguity.issue: The undefined term 'value matching mechanism' is used; the explanation in parentheses shows that a specific value (or omit for the whole template) is meant.
